Clear the environemnt and call libraries

```{r}

#install.packages("prospectr")
#install.packages("pls")

library(prospectr)
library(pls)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)

```

Note: if we are working on this together for version control, this will initially cause some issues! Best to find a common, accessible place to put a common dataset for testing.



Before running, raw datasets exported from Foss need to:
1) remove the second row of "Log(1/R)"
2) Write "Wavelength" in cell A1
3) Find and replace"sample no: " with ""
4) Check consistency of names with wetchem and are unique after being cut off with SpectraGryph
```{r}
#Read in and transpose spectral data, and move wavelength IDs into column names
##CA limas
dat_spectral1 = read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/CA_lima/Full_Set1_Spectra_for_R.csv",head=T,check.names=F)
##CF23
dat_spectral2 = read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/NIRS_Calibration/spectra_CF_all_t.csv",head=T,check.names=F)
##CVARS23
dat_spectral3=read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/CVARS_2023/nir_spectra_CVARS23_LIMAonly_formated_for_calibration_script.csv",head=T,check.names=F) #already transposed and formatted
#Culinary
dat_spectral4=read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/Sensory-culinary/Spectra/nir_spectra_culinary_sensory_set_for.cal.csv",head=T,check.names=F)#names appended to be same as recorded in foss with spaces replaced (were cut off in spectragryph)#additional samples added
##Davis24
dat_spectral5=read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/Davis_2024_SCRIDayNeutral/nirs_spectra_ucd2024_npgs_pretransposed.csv",head=T,check.names=F)
##CVARS24
dat_spectral6=read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/CVARS_2024/NIRS/cvars2024_7-28-25_spectra.csv",head=T,check.names=F)
##CF24
dat_spectral7=read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/Central_Ferry/2024_field/nir_spectra_CF2024.csv",head=T,check.names=F)
##UCD25
dat_spectral8=read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/PostDoc/LIMA_USDA_SCRI/Davis_2025/NIRS/ucd25_npgs_spectra_missing20.csv",head=T,check.names=F)
dat_spectral_pretransp<-full_join(dat_spectral1,dat_spectral2, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_pretransp2<-full_join(dat_spectral_pretransp,dat_spectral3, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_pretransp3<-full_join(dat_spectral_pretransp2,dat_spectral4, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_pretransp4<-full_join(dat_spectral_pretransp3,dat_spectral5, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_pretransp5<-full_join(dat_spectral_pretransp4,dat_spectral6, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_pretransp6<-full_join(dat_spectral_pretransp5,dat_spectral7, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_pretransp7<-full_join(dat_spectral_pretransp6,dat_spectral8, by = join_by(Wavelength))
dat_spectral_w.head = t(as.matrix(dat_spectral_pretransp7)) #includes wavelength header
dim(dat_spectral_w.head)

colnames(dat_spectral_w.head) = dat_spectral_w.head[1,] #sets wavelengths as column names
dat_spectral = dat_spectral_w.head[-1,] #removes first row that had contained wavelengths

```

```{r}
#Compute spectral pre-treatments

# Standard Normal Variate (SNV) #corrects for multiplicative effects
snv <- standardNormalVariate(dat_spectral)

# Compute the first derivative using the Savitzky-Golay filter
sg.1 <- savitzkyGolay(dat_spectral, p = 3, w = 11, m = 1)
sg.2 <- savitzkyGolay(dat_spectral, p = 3, w = 11, m = 2)

```


```{r}
#PCA on spectral data
pc_res = prcomp(dat_spectral,scale=T)
plot(pc_res)
autoplot(pc_res,label=T,label.size=2)

pc_res1 = prcomp(snv,scale=T)
plot(pc_res1)
autoplot(pc_res1,label=T,label.size=2)

pc_res2 = prcomp(sg.1,scale=T)
plot(pc_res2)
autoplot(pc_res2,label=T,label.size=2)

pc_res2 = prcomp(sg.2,scale=T)
plot(pc_res2)
autoplot(pc_res2,label=T,label.size=2)
```

```{r}
#Calculate mahalanobis distance of spectra for outlier detection
#no pretreatment
cov_regularized <- cov(dat_spectral) + diag(0.0001, ncol(dat_spectral)) # Add a small value to the diagonal so matrix algebra is computable
mahal_distances <- mahalanobis(dat_spectral, colMeans(dat_spectral), cov_regularized)

#Visualize mahalanobis distance with 99.5th percentile
perc_thresh <- quantile(mahal_distances, 0.995)
hist(mahal_distances, main = "Mahalanobis Distances with 99th percentile threshold",
     xlab = "Mahalanobis Distance", ylab = "Frequency", breaks = 30)
abline(v = perc_thresh, col = "red", lty = 2)

#snv
cov_regularized1 <- cov(snv) + diag(0.0001, ncol(snv)) # Add a small value to the diagonal so matrix algebra is computable
mahal_distances1 <- mahalanobis(snv, colMeans(snv), cov_regularized1)

hist(mahal_distances1, main = "Mahalanobis Distances with 99th percentile threshold",
     xlab = "Mahalanobis Distance", ylab = "Frequency", breaks = 30)
abline(v = perc_thresh, col = "red", lty = 2)

#sg1
cov_regularized2 <- cov(sg.1) + diag(0.0001, ncol(sg.1)) # Add a small value to the diagonal so matrix algebra is computable
mahal_distances2 <- mahalanobis(sg.1, colMeans(sg.1), cov_regularized2)

hist(mahal_distances2, main = "Mahalanobis Distances with 99th percentile threshold",
     xlab = "Mahalanobis Distance", ylab = "Frequency", breaks = 30)
abline(v = perc_thresh, col = "red", lty = 2)

#sg2
cov_regularized3 <- cov(sg.2) + diag(0.0001, ncol(sg.2)) # Add a small value to the diagonal so matrix algebra is computable
mahal_distances3 <- mahalanobis(sg.2, colMeans(sg.2), cov_regularized2)

hist(mahal_distances3, main = "Mahalanobis Distances with 99th percentile threshold",
     xlab = "Mahalanobis Distance", ylab = "Frequency", breaks = 30)
abline(v = perc_thresh, col = "red", lty = 2)

```

```{r}

#Apply thresholds to subset data

cat(Mahal_outs_perc, sep = "\n")
```

Testing pretreatments no pretreat, SNV, SG1, SG2 with 5fCV
```{r}

# Initialize results vector to store performance metrics
res_matr2 = matrix(NA,nrow=27,ncol=7) #Traits on columns, metrics on rows: RMSEP (corrected for bias) in each training set, ratio of percent deviation in each training set, r(pred,obs) in 5-fold CV in all samples, RMSEP (corrected for bias) in 8 samples
colnames(res_matr2) = c(unlist(colnames(dat_wetchem_spectral)[6:12]))
rownames(res_matr2) = c("Trait mean in all samples",
                        "Trait SD in all samples",
                       "r(foss,obs) in all samples",
                       "RMSEP in 5x CV no pretreatment",
                       "r(pred,obs) in 5x CV no pretreatment",
                       "ncomp in 5x CVno pretreatment",
                       "RMSEP LOO no pretreatment",
                       "r(pred,obs) in LOO no pretreatment", 
                       "ncomp in LOO no pretreatment",
                       "RMSEP in 5x CV in sg1",
                       "r(pred,obs) in 5x CV in sg1",
                       "ncomp in 5x CV in sg1",
                       "RMSEP LOO in sg1",
                       "r(pred,obs) in LOO sg1",
                       "ncomp in LOO in sg1",
                       "RMSEP in 5x CV in sg2",
                       "r(pred,obs) in 5x CV in sg2",
                       "ncomp in 5x CV in sg2",
                       "RMSEP LOO in sg2",
                       "r(pred,obs) in LOO sg2",
                       "ncomp in LOO in sg2",
                       "RMSEP in 5x CV in snv",
                       "r(pred,obs) in 5x CV in snv",
                       "ncomp in 5x CV in snv",
                       "RMSEP LOO in snv",
                       "r(pred,obs) in LOO in snv",
                       "ncomp in LOO in snv"
                       )
```

No pretreatment:
```{r}
for(i in 6:12){
  this.trait.name = colnames(dat_wetchem_spectral)[i]
  print(this.trait.name)

  ## Subset only the trait column of interest (with index i) and all of the spectral data, so that the latter can be fed into plsr as predictors
  dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait = dat_wetchem_spectral[,c(i,18:ncol(dat_wetchem_spectral))]
  res_matr2[1,i-5] = mean(dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait[,1],na.rm=T)
  res_matr2[2,i-5] = sd(dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait[,1],na.rm=T)

  ## Five-fold cross-validation in all samples

  pls_all_5fCV <- plsr(as.formula(paste(this.trait.name, "~ .")), ncomp = 20, validation = "CV", segments = 5,data=dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait) 
  plot(pls_all_5fCV)
  plot(RMSEP(pls_all_5fCV), legendpos = "topright")
  summary(pls_all_5fCV)
  plot(pls_all_5fCV, "loadings", comps = 1:5, legendpos = "topleft", 
       labels = , xlab = "nm")+ abline(h = 0)

    ncomp.onesigma.all.5fCV <- selectNcomp(pls_all_5fCV, method = "onesigma", plot = TRUE) 
    res_matr2[6,i-5]=print(ncomp.onesigma.all.5fCV)
  plot(RMSEP(pls_all_5fCV), legendpos = "topright")
  summary(pls_all_5fCV)
  if(ncomp.onesigma.all.5fCV == 0){
    res_matr2[4,i-5] = NA
    res_matr2[5,i-5] = NA}
  else{
    plot(pls_all_5fCV, ncomp = ncomp.onesigma.all.5fCV, asp = 1, line = TRUE) 
    res_matr2[4,i-5] = RMSEP(pls_all_5fCV,ncomp=ncomp.onesigma.all.5fCV)$val[[4]]
    res_matr2[5,i-5] = cor(pls_all_5fCV$validation$pred[,,ncomp.onesigma.all.5fCV],na.omit(dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait[,1]))
  }
}  
```

```{r}
    res_matr2[23,i-5] = NA}
  else{
    plot(pls_all_5fCV_snv, ncomp = ncomp.onesigma.snv.5fCV, asp = 1, line = TRUE) 
    res_matr2[22,i-5] = RMSEP(pls_all_5fCV_snv,ncomp=ncomp.onesigma.snv.5fCV)$val[[4]]
    res_matr2[23,i-5] = cor(pls_all_5fCV_snv$validation$pred[,,ncomp.onesigma.snv.5fCV],na.omit(dat_wetchem_spectral_snv_ThisTrait[,1]))
    }
}
```

No pretreatment stats (extended metrics) for 8 iterations of the model:
```{r}

calc_metrics <- function(observed, predicted, coef_det = TRUE) {
  keep <- is.finite(observed) & is.finite(predicted)
  obs  <- observed[keep]
  prd  <- predicted[keep]
  n    <- length(obs)
  if (n < 3L) {
    return(data.frame(
      r = NA_real_,
      R2 = NA_real_,
      RMSECV = NA_real_,
      bias = NA_real_,
      slope = NA_real_,
      intercept = NA_real_,
      n = n
    ))
  }

  ## Check for zero or undefined standard deviations
  sd_obs <- sd(obs)
  sd_prd <- sd(prd)

  r      <- cor(obs, prd, method = "pearson")
  ss_tot <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)
  ss_res <- sum((obs - prd)^2)
  data.frame(
    r      = r,
    R2     = if (coef_det) 1 - ss_res / ss_tot else r^2,
    RMSECV = sqrt(mean((obs - prd)^2)),
    bias   = mean(prd - obs),
    slope  = unname(coef(lm(prd ~ obs))[2]),
    n      = n
  )
}

validation_results <- list()
residual_plot_data <- data.frame()
ncomp_selected= c(Moisture_percent= 10,
                  Ash_percent=12,
                  TotalN_percent=12,
                  Protein_percent=18,
                  Fat_percent=17,
                  Starch_percent=12)

# Run the analysis 8 times
for (iteration in 1:8) {
  
  print(paste("Iteration:", iteration))
  
  set.seed(100 + iteration)
  for(i in 7:12){
    this.trait.name = colnames(dat_wetchem_spectral)[i]
    print(this.trait.name)
    
    ## Subset only the trait column of interest (with index i) and all of the spectral data, so that the latter can be fed into plsr as predictors
    dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait = dat_wetchem_spectral[,c(i,18:ncol(dat_wetchem_spectral))]
    
    ## Five-fold cross-validation in all samples
    ncomp<-ncomp_selected[this.trait.name]
    pls_all_5fCV <- plsr(as.formula(paste(this.trait.name, "~ .")), ncomp = ncomp,
                         validation = "CV", segments = 5,data=dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait) 
    plot(pls_all_5fCV)
    
    summary(pls_all_5fCV)
   
    ## Extract FIVE-FOLD OUT-OF-FOLD predictions
    predicted <-as.vector(pls_all_5fCV$validation$pred[,,ncomp]) 
    
    ## Observed wet chemistry values
    observed <-dat_wetchem_spectral_ThisTrait[,1]
    keep_observed <- is.finite(observed)
    
    observed <- observed[keep_observed]
    
    ## Calculate validation statistics
    metrics <-calc_metrics(observed = observed,predicted = predicted)
    
    
    ## Add trait and number of components
    metrics$Trait <- this.trait.name
    metrics$ncomp <- ncomp
    metrics$Iteration <- iteration
    
    ## Store
    validation_results[[paste(this.trait.name, iteration, sep = "_")]] <- metrics
    
    ## Print
    print(metrics)
}
}

## Combine all nutrients
validation_results_df <-do.call(rbind, validation_results)

rownames(validation_results_df) <- NULL

## View final table
print(validation_results_df, digits = 3)
```
